result: The root cause: `routes/web.ts` registered the archive route as `posts.get('/archive/:date*', ...)`, but `:date*` isn't Hono's multi-segment wildcard syntax — Hono parsed it as a literal single-segment param named `date*`. That meant the actual `date` param was never populated (causing the 422 on `/posts/archive/2026`, where validation saw `date` as missing) and any path with a second segment (`/2026/08`) simply had no matching route (404). I changed it to `:date{.+}`, Hono's correct "one-or-more segments" capture syntax, in `routes/web.ts:35`, which now correctly feeds the full `2026` or `2026/08` string into `PostController.archive()`'s existing `ArchiveParamSchema` validation and prefix-match query — no other logic needed to change. I also added a `posts.archive` test suite in `tests/PostController.test.ts` covering zero-padded and unpadded months, year-only archives, empty periods, and out-of-range months. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (7/7), and `bunx guren check` shows no new issues.
